# graviteeam_environment_metadata (Data Source)

Reads Gravitee AM environment metadata such as data planes and data sources

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graviteeam_environment_metadata" "data_planes" {
  kind = "data_planes"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) Metadata kind. Supported values: data_planes, data_sources

### Read-Only

- `result_json` (String) JSON string containing the environment metadata response
